title: A Cinematic Journey with our Alumni
description: The Student Welfare Department, in association with the Alumni Cell of Canara Engineering College (CEC), organized a special event for the exclusive trailer release of the Kannada movie Prathyartha on 22-01-2025. The event featured distinguished alumni – Mr. Ramnath Shanbhag, Mr. Vittal Divakar, and Mr.  Sushanth Bhandary. Mr. Ramnath Shanbhag shared his cinematic journey, which began at CEC, with an audience of around 496 first-year students. As a tribute to his alma mater, he chose CEC for the first-ever trailer release of Prathyartha, expressing gratitude for its role in shaping his career. Coordinated by Mrs. Jayashree K from the ECE department, the event was well-organized and inspiring. It concluded with an interactive session, where students engaged with the alumni, gaining insights into the filmmaking industry.

title: Talk on Placement Assistance for preparing for upcoming Placement Drive
description: Ms. Chaitra Nayak, Tier 1 Analyst at Riskonnect Inc. and alumna of the ISE Department, CEC (Class of 2024), addressed the final-year students on 4th September 2024 in Lecture Hall LH 204. She shared valuable guidance and insights to help students prepare for the upcoming placement drive. Emphasizing the importance of the first round, she encouraged students to put in sincere effort and perform well right from the start. Ms. Chaitra also offered practical tips on how to approach each phase of the selection process and succeed in the subsequent rounds.
